title: BuildCommit
description: Typed payload emitted by every worker-adapter when it lands a change in response to a finding. Closes the dual-loop contract triad on the BUILD_COMMITTED side: every commit must (a) name the finding it addresses, (b) name the SpoofStack layer it touches, (c) enumerate files changed, (d) carry the acceptance-command result so the verifier can gate issue closure on a real CI signal — not on a self-report. Authoritative version: v1.0 (CTO, CLO-108, 2026-05-16).

schema_version.description: Optional semver of this contract that the emitter targets. Allows forward-compat as the schema evolves. Absent = treat as 1.0.

sha.description: Full 40-character lowercase git commit SHA on the upstream branch. Short SHAs are not accepted because they are not collision-stable across the SpoofStack repo's lifetime.

addresses_finding_id.description: Identifier of the finding / issue this commit is intended to close. Accepts a Paperclip issue identifier (e.g. CLO-27) or a fully-qualified probe id (e.g. runtime.frida_memory_maps). Either form lets the verifier resolve the originating FINDING side of the dual-loop triad.

layer.description: SpoofStack layer the change targets, per BEST-STACK.md §II. L0a is Stability's host-compose layer; L0b..L6 are Builder lanes. Use only the canonical tokens — no aliases.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of every file the commit touched (added, modified, deleted, or renamed). Minimum one entry — a zero-file BuildCommit is a contract violation. The verifier cross-checks this list against `git show --name-only $sha`.

acceptance_cmd_result.description: Result of running the acceptance command(s) declared on the parent issue. The verifier reads `passed`; humans read `log_excerpt` for debugging. `cmd` is the literal shell invocation; `exit_code` is the process exit code. A BuildCommit may not declare `passed: true` while `exit_code != 0`.

cmd.description: The acceptance command, exactly as executed (after any harness templating expansion).

exit_code.description: Process exit code. 0 = green; any non-zero = red.

passed.description: Convenience boolean. MUST equal (exit_code == 0). The verifier rejects the commit on mismatch.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the acceptance run, in milliseconds.

log_excerpt.description: Tail of combined stdout/stderr, suitable for a comment body. Truncated to ~4KB by the harness.

log_artifact_url.description: Optional URL to the full log artifact (object-storage, Paperclip work-product, etc.).

worker.description: Optional provenance block — which worker-adapter emitted this BuildCommit, what version, and the contract version it claims to satisfy. Helps the verifier route follow-up issues back to the correct lane.

tier.description: Task tier this commit was attempted at (see worker.yaml tier_max).

container_image.description: Digest-pinned container image the commit targets, when relevant (L0a/L0b commits). Must include an @sha256:… digest — tag-only references are rejected (`enforce-spoofstack-discipline` Gate 3).

stack_layers.description: Optional snapshot of the post-commit SpoofStack layer-set (mirrors AGENTS.md BUILD_COMMITTED body). Use when the commit changes multi-layer composition.

proposal_id.description: Optional reference to the mutation proposal (mutations/proposals/<id>.json) this commit fulfils.
